import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
# J2:K6 - end of May 2022, end of Jun 2022, end of Jul 2022
# open if not closed before first day of month AND not created after last day of month
# May 2022: first day 2022-05-01, last day 2022-05-31
# Jun 2022: first day 2022-06-01, last day 2022-06-30
# Jul 2022: first day 2022-07-01, last day 2022-07-31
for r in range(2,7):
    ws.cell(r,10).value = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G{r},D:D,\"\",D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,5,1),D:D,\"<\"&DATE(2022,6,1),C:C,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,5,31))'.format(r=r)
    ws.cell(r,11).value = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G{r},D:D,\"\",D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,6,1),D:D,\"<\"&DATE(2022,7,1),C:C,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,6,30))'.format(r=r)
    ws.cell(r,12).value = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G{r},D:D,\"\",D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,7,1),D:D,\"<\"&DATE(2022,8,1),C:C,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,7,31))'.format(r=r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
